objective: Train and promote an action-conditioned world model only after it significantly beats every declared reproducible baseline on frozen simulation, cross-embodiment, and real-robot trials.
agent_loop: observe per-trial action, physics, appearance, embodiment, and temporal failures
select one bounded data or optimization intervention
run matched-seed validation without touching frozen test trials
reject any intervention that regresses a mandatory metric
run frozen benchmark and real-robot tests only for a validation winner

paper_to_implementation.adopted: explicit cross-embodiment split, pixel/action alignment audit, appearance/dynamics decoupling through action-adapter-first training
paper_to_implementation.not_yet_implemented: the paper's complete unseen-embodiment architecture and few-shot appearance recovery

paper_to_implementation.adopted: 57-frame action-conditioned Wan2.2 baseline, 9-frame history, autoregressive-ready overlapping clips
paper_to_implementation.not_yet_implemented: an officially documented end-to-end training recipe; the public README still marks training code TODO

paper_to_implementation.adopted: long-horizon memory is a mandatory ablation and evaluation axis
physics and action following are promotion metrics; visual quality cannot substitute for either
frozen multimodal test plus real-platform evidence is required
paper_to_implementation.not_yet_implemented: full benchmark generation and server submission

declared_baselines: candidate ablations: no action, no history, no grouped split, action-adapter only

promotion_gate.statistics: paired one-sided bootstrap lower confidence bound
promotion_gate.rule: every required metric must exceed every declared baseline with lower confidence bound > 0

current_evidence.cpu_tests: 16 targeted tests passed with targeted Ruff checks
current_evidence.real_parquet_smoke: WORKING: 2 episodes, 4 clips, BWM loader shape [1,57,14]
current_evidence.gpu_training: WORKING smoke only: one 57-frame, 9-history, 14D action-adapter optimization step saved a 199275904-byte checkpoint; full campaign and model-quality evaluation are not started

claim_boundary: No SOTA or real-robot claim is allowed until the promotion gate passes on actual artifacts.
